note: Flat name -> address map. Push core addresses are supplied by Push, not deployed by this repo; StakeDummy is demo-only and written by demo/script/00_setup/02_DeployStakeDummy.s.sol. Unknown keys are committed as the zero address so the file's shape is fixed and a gap surfaces as MissingAddress rather than a JSON parse error.

evidence.CEAFactory: THE AUTHORITY IS THE VAULT, NEVER A STANDALONE PROBE. Returned by Vault.CEAFactory(), and that factory's VAULT() points back to the same Vault. computeCEA and getCEAForPushAccount agree with the CEA actually deployed on-chain (isCEA -> true). Verified 2026-09-06.

deprecated.note: Recorded so a stale address found in an older document is recognisable as stale rather than mistaken for live. HAVING CODE IS NOT SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE - this factory is live, answers computeCEA, and is internally consistent; it is simply not the one the Vault deploys through. Choosing it fails SILENTLY: the demo predicted 0x30414c4b... while the Vault deployed 0xCF173d1b..., the mandate pinned the ghost as beneficiary, and 5 USDC was staked to an address with no code. Nothing reverted until Act 4a.
deprecated.whyTheyDiffer: computeCEA is a CREATE2 prediction over both CEA_PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION and address(this). Both differ between the two factories, so the same salt yields different addresses. Each factory is internally consistent; only one is wired to the Vault.
